- Keyboard Space activated all 13 expected panel headings, each with its selected aria-pressed state.

- At the 375px frame setting, content and scroll widths both measured 360px. Desktop content and scroll widths both measured 1702px. Screenshots showed readable grouping, wrapping and visible focus without horizontal overflow.
- The created QA tab was closed afterward.
